scripts.deploy: sh ../tools/deploy-guard.sh sync pwa && pnpm --dir ../pwa install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir ../pwa run build && wrangler deploy --message "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.deploy:staging: sh ../tools/deploy-guard.sh sync pwa && pnpm --dir ../pwa install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir ../pwa run build && wrangler deploy --env staging --message "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && wrangler deploy --dry-run && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging
